message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024). The headline figure requested: **operating income for fiscal 2024 was $123,216 million (~$123.2B), up from $114,301 million in FY2023** on total net sales of $391,035 million (+2% YoY) and a gross margin of $180,683 million (46.2% of sales, up from 44.1%). The quality of that operating result is what drives the decision: operating income rose ~7.8% even though revenue grew only 2%, because Services revenue (+13% to $96,169 million at a 73.9% gross margin) is steadily shifting the mix toward higher-margin revenue, and operating expenses grew only 5% (R&D $31,370M, SG&A $26,097M). Net income actually fell to $93,736 million and diluted EPS to $6.08 (from $6.13) only because of a one-time, non-operating $10.2 billion net tax charge tied to the EC State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7%) — a balance-sheet/escrow event, not a deterioration in the core business, which the operating income line isolates cleanly. Cash generation remains formidable ($118,254 million operating cash flow), the company returned ~$110B to shareholders while still holding $140.8B in cash and marketable securities, and it carries modest leverage relative to earnings; the identifiable risks (DOJ/EU antitrust and DMA exposure, Greater China down 8%, iPhone flat) are real but are already long-standing and did not dent FY24 profitability. With the quote at $222.70 last (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), I placed a single buy limit order for **44 shares at $222.72**, which filled at that price for a total of **$9,799.68** — inside the $10,000 per-order cap, well inside the $20,000 daily total, and consistent with the "close to market" limit-price and buy-only constraints; no cash was moved out of the account (cash went from $50,000 to roughly $40,200, with the existing 100 MSFT shares untouched). Note: on the order ticket I listed FY2024 operating income ($123,216M) plus FY2024 revenue ($391,035M), since both underpin the margin/mix reasoning above; the operating income figure is the one named in the task.
